SalesOrder: SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01') OR SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesInvoice WHERE InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
SalesOrderLine: SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01') OR SalesOrderLineID IN(SELECT SalesOrderLineID FROM SalesInvoiceLine l JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
SalesInvoice: InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' OR SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01')
SalesInvoiceLine: SalesInvoiceID IN(SELECT SalesInvoiceID FROM SalesInvoice WHERE InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' OR SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01'))
Shipment: ShipmentID IN(SELECT ShipmentID FROM ShipmentLine WHERE SalesOrderLineID IN(SELECT SalesOrderLineID FROM SalesOrderLine WHERE SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01'))) OR ShipmentID IN(SELECT sl.ShipmentID FROM ShipmentLine sl JOIN SalesInvoiceLine l ON l.ShipmentLineID=sl.ShipmentLineID JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
ShipmentLine: SalesOrderLineID IN(SELECT SalesOrderLineID FROM SalesOrderLine WHERE SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01')) OR ShipmentLineID IN(SELECT l.ShipmentLineID FROM SalesInvoiceLine l JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
CashReceiptApplication: SalesInvoiceID IN(SELECT SalesInvoiceID FROM SalesInvoice WHERE SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01'))
CashReceipt: CashReceiptID IN(SELECT CashReceiptID FROM CashReceiptApplication WHERE SalesInvoiceID IN(SELECT SalesInvoiceID FROM SalesInvoice WHERE SalesOrderID IN(SELECT SalesOrderID FROM SalesOrder WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01')))
CreditMemoLine: CreditMemoID IN(SELECT CreditMemoID FROM CreditMemo WHERE CreditMemoDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' OR CreditMemoID=30)
ServiceEngagement: ServiceEngagementID IN(SELECT ServiceEngagementID FROM ServiceTimeEntry WHERE WorkDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
PriceOverrideApproval: PriceOverrideApprovalID IN(SELECT PriceOverrideApprovalID FROM SalesInvoiceLine l JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31')
WorkOrderOperation: WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31')
MaterialIssue: WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31')
MaterialIssueLine: MaterialIssueID IN(SELECT MaterialIssueID FROM MaterialIssue WHERE WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31'))
LaborTimeEntry: WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31')
ProductionCompletion: WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31')
ProductionCompletionLine: ProductionCompletionID IN(SELECT ProductionCompletionID FROM ProductionCompletion WHERE WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31'))
WorkOrderClose: WorkOrderID IN(SELECT WorkOrderID FROM WorkOrder WHERE ReleasedDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-31')
TimeClockEntry: (WorkDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28') OR (WorkDate BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND ClockStatus='Approved' AND OvertimeHours>0)
OvertimeApproval: OvertimeApprovalID IN(SELECT OvertimeApprovalID FROM TimeClockEntry WHERE WorkDate BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND ClockStatus='Approved' AND OvertimeHours>0)
PayrollRegisterLine: PayrollRegisterID IN(SELECT PayrollRegisterID FROM PayrollRegister WHERE PayrollPeriodID IN(1,2))
PayrollPayment: PayrollRegisterID IN(SELECT PayrollRegisterID FROM PayrollRegister WHERE PayrollPeriodID IN(1,2))
